verdict.rationale: Viam documents agent-driven operation directly: an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person or program can. The agent guidance covers listing resources and status and issuing collision-checked motion via the motion service. The CLI can call any machine API method JSON-in/JSON-out, and SDKs exist in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter. Scoped credentials are only implied by the fleet API's 'manage permissions and authorization'. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped API keys or roles for agent authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent commanding real hardware end-to-end.
